purpose: Define a named set of controls, required result thresholds, evidence expectations and evaluation cadence for a system/package/deployment context.

topics.name: Compliance Profile
topics.purpose: Define a named set of controls, required result thresholds, evidence expectations and evaluation cadence for a system/package/deployment context.

semantics.identity_rule: Each compliance profile has explicit identity/version.
semantics.result_rule: Profile-level status is derived from exact control evaluations.
semantics.unknown_rule: Missing required control evaluation cannot silently yield compliant.
semantics.authority_rule: Compliant status does not grant runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: profile pass inferred from majority only without rule
